label: vulnerable
explanation: User-controlled searchKey is concatenated into a dynamic SOQL string. An attacker can close the quote and alter the WHERE clause (e.g. to remove the filter or probe other fields). USER_MODE limits data to what the user may see but does not stop query manipulation.
expected_remediation: Use a bind variable (Database.queryWithBinds or a static query with :searchKey)
Or escape input with String.escapeSingleQuotes before concatenation
sources: Trailhead - Secure Server-Side Development: Mitigate SOQL Injection
severity_rationale: Severity criteria v1 (10 Nov 2026): injectable, but reachable only by authenticated internal users and partly contained by USER_MODE and with sharing - the attacker can alter the query but cannot read records or fields beyond their own access. Medium = real flaw limited by another control.
